themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: This theme covers AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, analyze data, and generate insights with minimal human intervention.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: This theme focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and refactor code, including research on their effectiveness and security.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: This theme encompasses a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to assist in various aspects of research, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: This theme covers AI applications that condense large amounts of text, such as articles, transcripts, or research papers, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: This theme explores how AI is being integrated into design workflows and research processes to enhance creativity, efficiency, and user understanding.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: This theme examines the creation and use of AI-generated personas or simulated user data for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: This theme focuses on AI tools and techniques used to automate software testing, including UI testing, performance testing, and quality assurance.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: This theme delves into the research and development of AI chatbots, their capabilities, limitations, and impact on user interaction and understanding.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: This theme covers how AI is used to analyze customer data and feedback to generate actionable insights for product development and marketing.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: This theme addresses platforms and environments specifically designed to facilitate AI research, development, and experimentation.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
